title: Regional aircraft exploration
description: From a regional query to a spatial picture.
scope: A historical regional position snapshot. Coverage depends on the source; this is not continuous tracking.

title: Earthquakes, in context
description: See public event records plotted inside the application.
scope: The captured run displays at most the first 150 positions. Historical public event data, not a current alert service.

title: Company relationship review
description: Follow a reported LEI relationship to its source.
scope: Accounting consolidation relationships, not natural-person beneficial ownership or a complete chain of intermediaries.

title: Voice enrollment & comparison
description: A recorded enrollment and verification interaction.
scope: Research speech examples. A successful comparison does not establish performance across languages, devices, noise or replay attacks.
